items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Claude Hopkins went back in the Zanzibar. And I went in as the music director

ctx.x: That was -- you know, when I came out of the three months with Louie at the Zanzibar, I went back as -- Claude Hopkins went back in the Zanzibar. And I went in as the music director and had charge of the small band that played the dance music between shows. And I was so -- music director for the show -- the band that Claude Hopkins played in.
